spans.s:
ऐरावण m. (-णः) INDRA'S elephant.
 E. इरावत् the ocean, अण् affix of
descent; ocean-born: न is changed irregularly to ण.

ऐरावत m. (-तः)
 1. INDRA'S elephant.
 2. The same, considered as the
elephant of the north quarter.
 3. An orange.
 4. A fruit, (Arto-
carpus lacucha.)
 5. A serpent, one of the chiefs of the Naga or
serpent race, inhabiting the infernal regions.
 f. (-ती)
 1.

. A particular kind of it.
 3. The female of INDRA'S elephant.
 4.
The Ravi river in the Panjab.
 n. (-तं) INDRA'S bow unbent, the
rainbow.
 E. इरावत् water-having; that is, the ocean, a cloud, &c.
अण् affix implying origin or descent; born from the ocean, (the
elephant,) proceeding from watery clouds, (lightning, &c.)
